resources.string: Offline · planned last night at ⁨%s⁩. Only options still ahead are shown.

Each night, on Wi-Fi and while charging, the app plans tomorrow\'s usual trips (Home to places with a routine, and your saved trips), so they are there with no signal in the morning. At most %d searches a night.
Set a saved place as Home (🏠 below) to include your routines.
Use “%s” as your Home? Night refresh plans from it.
